game.name: Slay the Spire
game.mode: unmodded; normal acquisition with unlocks available; excludes mobile-specific bugs and Custom/Endless-only rules unless explicitly noted

project_policy.meaning: Preserve conditional probabilities and intended dependencies with reproducible project randomness; original PRNG/seed mapping and incidental stream coupling are not requirements.

interpretation.characters: Normal acquisition restriction, not a statement that relic effects cease working if obtained by another character through mods/custom rules.
interpretation.triggers: Semantic event labels, not Rust callback names or a fully specified action-queue order.
interpretation.state_and_reset: Conceptual gameplay state; exact numeric serialized counter sentinels are stated only in retained qualified local primary rules.
interpretation.key: Reuse all 178 existing public catalog keys, including non-display aliases. Not a claim that each key is already implemented in the Rust runtime. Fallback keys are catalog additions only.
interpretation.rng: Randomness of effects after acquisition. none means no relic-local random selection, not deterministic acquisition. RNG-001 applies; original PRNG parity is not required.
interpretation.local_static: Retained independently worded source findings and unresolved boundary codes from existing public research, at that report's exact qualification. Local findings can refine tooltip summaries without promoting whole-game fidelity.
interpretation.acquisition: Normal source families plus per-relic restrictions; combine with global pool and unlock rules. Not an exhaustive event-by-event eligibility table.
interpretation.effect: Readable normalized description, not executable rules or a byte-exact copy of localized game text.

global_rules.rule: Ordinary non-chest relic tier roll: Common 50%, Uncommon 33%, Rare 17%; particular sources can use different distributions.
Chest tier probabilities Common/Uncommon/Rare: small 75/25/0%, medium 35/50/15%, large 0/75/25%.
Ordinary relics generally cannot be offered again once encountered in a run; pool exhaustion uses fallbacks. Circlet is repeatable.
Normal character and unlock eligibility apply before offering relics; this catalog assumes unlocks are available and does not specify unlock progression.
Relic acquisition order can affect callback and action-queue order. Do not replace documented hook phases with one global alphabetical relic order.
Permanent master deck additions differ from combat hand/draw/discard additions; eggs, Ceramic Fish, Darkstone Periapt, and ordinary removal/transform operations must preserve that distinction.

global_uncertainties: Target version is PC v2.3, but the sources are current community documentation frozen by revision ID, not a captured v2.3 executable or official specification. Values and bug behavior require oracle tests before claiming parity.
No game runtime, save/reload oracle, or all-character simulator test was used to verify these mechanics. Structural completeness does not prove behavioral completeness.

RNG-001 supersedes original PRNG/seed/call-consumption parity requirements. Conditional candidate support, chance masses, rejection/history and intended gameplay dependencies still need evidence; this dataset is not a full probability-law proof.
Detailed unlock conditions, all event prerequisites, shop rounding, custom-mode exceptions, and exhaustive interactions with every card/potion/enemy are outside this reference pass.
State descriptions are conceptual; raw game counter sentinel encodings and simulator implementation status are not inferred from documentation.
